scope: Beijing municipal parks ticketing guidance for foreign visitors; Jingshan Park policy conflict review

latestSpecificGuide.claim: Foreign visitors are instructed to call at least one day in advance, provide identity details, and purchase at the south-gate information desk on the visit day; the guide says tickets are not sold on site to foreign visitors without that reservation.

details.reservationWindow: At least one day in advance

otherOfficialGuidance.claim: Foreign visitors may use the official Changyou Gongyuan platform, but first-time real-name binding requires a mainland China phone number; onsite service windows are also described as an option.
The FAQ says advance reservation is not required and describes online advance purchase and onsite ticket sales at park gates.
The municipal park page describes online time-slot tickets through Changyou Gongyuan up to seven days ahead and onsite ticket purchase.

records.userFacingRecommendation: Because official pages conflict and the newest page is specifically about foreign visitors, treat the phone reservation instruction as a risk to verify before visiting. Do not promise walk-up ticket purchase to foreign visitors. If unable to call, contact the park or Beijing visitor hotline / use the official platform only after confirming eligibility; keep the on-site option explicitly unconfirmed.

records.topic: Beijing municipal park ticketing for foreign visitors
records.claim: The official guide lists nine municipal parks on Changyou Gongyuan and states that foreign visitors can book using passports or Foreign Permanent Resident ID Cards. It also describes e-ticket QR code entry with valid ID.
records.limitation: The 12345 FAQ notes first-time online real-name identity binding may require a mainland China mobile number. Onsite ticketing is described in some FAQs, but the newest Jingshan-specific guide contradicts this for foreign visitors without advance phone reservation.

records.claim: Beijing Municipal Administration Center of Parks states it has not authorized third-party ticket-purchasing platforms for municipal parks; Changyou Gongyuan is the official ticketing platform.
records.recommendation: Do not recommend third-party tickets as official unless the attraction itself confirms an authorized channel.
